title: Spinach and Orzo Salad
description: Orzo pasta is tossed with spinach, red onion, feta cheese, pine nuts, basil, olive oil and balsamic vinegar, creating a delicious, colorful cold salad.
ingredients: 1 (10 ounce) package baby spinach leaves, finely chopped

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add orzo and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain and rinse with cold water. Transfer to a large bowl and stir in spinach, feta, onion, pine nuts, basil and white pepper. Toss with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. Refrigerate and serve cold.

video.description: Full of flavor and plenty of good, nutritious ingredients, you’ll be encouraging everyone’s good health when you bring a big bowl of this light pasta salad to the potluck. Combine cooked and cold-rinsed orzo pasta with fresh spinach, crumbled feta cheese, red onion, pine nuts, basil and white pepper. Create a quick dressing of olive oil and balsamic vinegar, toss into salad and give it a good chill before serving. So simple to make and delicious to eat!
